hierarchy.h1: font-serif text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tight text-[#2C2A26]
hierarchy.h2: font-serif text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#2C2A26]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing and extremely clear layout. High contrast borders resembling physical printed newspaper blocks. High accessibility for all age groups.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style block grid, primarily 1-column on mobile, up to 3 columns on desktop. gap-6 or gap-8.

job_card.style: bg-[#FCFAF5] border-2 border-[#2C2A26] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#2C2A26] rounded-sm transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_#2C2A26]
job_card.internal_layout: Flex column, gap-4. Title at top, metadata (dates) in middle, status stamp absolute positioned or top right, actions at bottom.

status_stamp.applied: inline-block border-2 border-[#3A5A40] text-[#3A5A40] font-mono font-bold px-3 py-1 uppercase tracking-widest -rotate-2 bg-transparent opacity-90 text-sm
status_stamp.unapplied: inline-block border-2 border-[#8C3A3A] text-[#8C3A3A] font-mono font-bold px-3 py-1 uppercase tracking-widest rotate-2 bg-transparent opacity-90 text-sm

timer_badge.layout: Flex row, items-center gap-2. Use vintage_timer_icon if appropriate, or a Lucide clock icon.

buttons.primary: bg-[#2C2A26] text-[#FCFAF5] font-serif font-bold text-lg px-6 py-3 border-2 border-[#2C2A26] hover:bg-transparent hover:text-[#2C2A26] transition-colors shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_#59554D]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#2C2A26] font-serif font-bold text-lg px-6 py-3 border-2 border-[#2C2A26] hover:bg-[#EBE5D9] transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-transparent text-[#8C3A3A] font-serif font-bold text-lg px-6 py-3 border-2 border-[#8C3A3A] hover:bg-[#8C3A3A] hover:text-[#FCFAF5] transition-colors

smart_paste_modal.style: bg-[#F4F1EA] border-4 border-[#2C2A26] p-8 max-w-2xl w-full relative outline-none shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_#2C2A26]
smart_paste_modal.textarea: font-mono text-base bg-transparent border-b-2 border-dashed border-[#59554D] w-full p-2 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#2C2A26] min-h-[150px]

pwa_banner.style: fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full bg-[#EBE5D9] border-t-4 border-[#2C2A26] p-4 flex justify-between items-center z-50 shadow-2xl

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-[#59554D] focus:border-[#2C2A26] font-mono text-lg py-2 px-1 outline-none w-full placeholder:text-[#59554D]/50 rounded-none

animation_and_interaction.hover_effects: Translates cards slightly up (-translate-y-1), increases brutalist shadow distance. Keep it snappy and mechanical, like physical objects.
animation_and_interaction.page_load: Subtle fade-in with a very slight scale-up to mimic a notice being placed on a board.
animation_and_interaction.stamp_animation: When a user or admin marks a job as applied/unapplied, animate the stamp to scale down from 1.5 to 1.0 rapidly to mimic physical stamping.

applied_stamp.description: Red transparent vintage stamp that says APPLIED. Use if a graphic is preferred over CSS.

timer_icon.description: Sepia vintage pocket watch line art. Use alongside the countdown timer text.

general_instructions_for_main_agent: Use a CSS grain/noise overlay on the main background to achieve the vintage paper feel (e.g., repeating SVG noise pattern). This is lighter and scales better than a massive image.
Ensure ALL interactive and informational elements include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='apply-link'`, `data-testid='smart-paste-btn'`).
Mobile PWA setup is mandatory: configure `manifest.json` properly and implement the install prompt banner.
Countdown Timer Logic: color-code days left: Green for >15 days, Amber for 3-15 days, Red for <=3 days or overdue.
Admin access: Single hardcoded user (bidyadhar / Bidyadhar1!).
Use `lucide-react` for icons with a sepia/charcoal stroke color and stroke-width of 1.5 to fit the letterpress/vintage aesthetic.
All components should be extremely readable and accessible (large text, high contrast borders). No low-contrast text.
